test_tensor_operators: test that Tensorizer transforms scalar plus, exp, sum, and log operators into MatrixAdd, MatrixExp, MatrixSum, and MatrixLog
test_matrix_scale: test that Tensorizer transforms scalar multiplication between a matrix and scalar into MatrixScale nodes
test_not_transformed: test that scalar multiplication between two scalars is not transformed by Tensorizer
test_errors: test that Tensorizer reports an error when matrix multiplication operand dimensions are incompatible
build_bmg_graph: build a Bean Machine graph using BMGRuntime accumulate_graph with random variable and functional decorators
